takeaway: The planned backtest disproved the idea that short-span growth readings hold the forecasts back: requiring 3- or 7-day spans made every score worse. CodeRabbit reported $100M ARR and 400,000 monthly users. No run on Nov 17; today's changes span two days.

findings.heading: Longer measurement spans make forecasts worse
findings.text: Re-scoring the Nov 1-11 forecasts with deltas over at least 3 or 7 days lowered the top-100 rank correlation from 0.398 to 0.384 and 0.353, and the top-15 hit rate from 32% to 27% and 23%. No setting changes.

findings.heading: CodeRabbit: $100M ARR, 400,000 monthly users
findings.text: The AI code-review company reported $100M ARR and 400,000 monthly active users on Nov 12, and 120,000 daily active users in its press release.

findings.heading: A Blender AI add-on's stars were purged
findings.text: hitkeeen/blender-ai-mcp-addon fell from 1,811 stars to 34 in two days. It had been reviewed as organic because of its 74 open issues; it is now reviewed as inorganic.

findings.heading: Claude-BugHunter accelerates
findings.text: The bug-hunting skill bundle gained 3,095 stars over two days, to 9,834: 1,548 a day, up from 878.

findings.heading: HeyGen: over 40 million users
findings.text: HeyGen's Avatar 6 release on Nov 17 says it now reaches over 40 million users.

caveats: No collection ran on Nov 17; changes since Nov 16 span two days and are shown per day.
ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui's +2,000 may partly reflect a misread Nov 16 page figure.
Hacker News and npm remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
